titulo: How I Work With You in 3 Clear Steps
descripcion: Staying compliant with SUNAT is stress-free with my direct personal guidance.
paso_1_titulo: Step 1: I Personally Review Your Case
paso_1_desc: We access your tax mailbox, receipts, and accounts to pinpoint your exact status.
paso_2_titulo: Step 2: I Plan Your Tax Strategy
paso_2_desc: I calculate your deductions, file withholding exemptions, and organize any back taxes.
paso_3_titulo: Step 3: I File Your Taxes on Time
paso_3_desc: We file punctually with SUNAT to prevent penalties and claim your tax refunds.
